BH
Breanne Hill Actress & Founder/CEO of Melillo Skincare · Beauty doesn't need fixing — only nourishing
About
Beauty doesn't need fixing — only nourishing. I've spent my career hearing the opposite. Film sets are gorgeous places to wreck your skin. Hours in makeup under hot lights, five a.m. calls, recycled air, coffee instead of sleep. I know exactly what skin endures when the job says you can't take the day off. I'm Breanne Hill — actress (Frontier, Rampage, San Andreas) and founder & CEO of Melillo Skincare. Melillo started the way most honest things do: with a problem that kept following me home. I wanted skincare built on botanicals and time-honored plant traditions — simple, effective, and kind to skin that already works hard. So I built it. Natural skincare, made from the earth, crafted in small batches. WHAT I BELIEVE: • Aging isn't something to fear — it's something to do with glowing skin. • "Natural" should still mean effective. Every formula has to earn its place. • Resilience — in skin and in work — comes from getting comfortable being uncomfortable. WHAT I'M BUILDING: • Melillo Skincare — small-batch face and body essentials (Aloe Glow Mist, Botanic Serum, Clarifying Clay, and Bare Body Oil lead the line) for people who dare to age and insist on glow. • CG&B Film Co — the production company I co-founded, where the storytelling side of my career lives. LET'S CONNECT IF: • You buy, stock, or write about clean beauty and want a founder-led brand with a real story. • You work in film, TV, or content and want to talk production or partnership. • You're building something of your own and want to trade notes on starting from scratch. The shop link is in my Featured section below. For anything else, message me here — I read everything.
Fits the 2,600-character limit as-is.
FAQ

Good questions.

Is this really free?

Yes. No invoice, no catch. Think of it as a sample of my work — you keep everything either way.

Why me?

I rebuild LinkedIn profiles for founders and creators. Your work was one clear line away from a profile that sells it — so I wrote that line.

Can I edit your copy?

Please do. It's a starting point — your voice is the final judge.

What if I don't like it?

Keep the parts you like, skip the rest. No hard feelings — the files are still yours.

How do I get all this onto my profile?

Every section has a copy button — copy, paste into LinkedIn, done. Your banner and photo files arrive by email at full size, ready to upload.
